concepts.name: Unit 2 Two-dimensional Motion Introducti
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 2 Two-dimensional motion Introduction Kinematics is the study of motion without considering its causes
concepts.deep_explanation: For example, studying the motion of a football without considering what forces cause or change its motion
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Unit 2 Two-dimensional motion Introducti from page 30.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Unit 2 Two-dimensional motion Introducti with adjacent topics in Chapter 2.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Unit 2 Two-dimensional motion Introduction Kinematics is the study of motion without considering its causes (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ12ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] For example, studying the motion of a football without considering what forces cause or change its motion — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 30 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።
